learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn how to use words to describe the color, size, shape, or quality of Naming Words.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Look at an apple. Is it just an apple? No, it is a RED and SWEET apple! 🍎 Words like 'red' and 'sweet' make our sentences beautiful. Let's meet the Describing Words!

lesson_modules.module_title: ✨ What are Describing Words? (विशेषता बताने वाले शब्द)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Words that tell us more about a Naming Word (Noun) are called Describing Words. They are also called Adjectives (विशेषण). They tell us how a thing looks, feels, or tastes.
All color names and shape names are describing words! They easily tell us how a naming word looks.
Words that tell us how big, small, or how many things there are, are also describing words.
How do you feel today? How does the candy taste? These answer words are describing words too!

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ In the phrase 'Green leaf', which is the describing word?
❓ Which describing word fits best for an elephant?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank with a color word: The sky is ______.
subjective_practice.hint: What color is the sky? (Blue / Green)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Underline the describing word: 'It is a sunny day.'
subjective_practice.hint: What kind of day is it?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write a describing word for a lemon.
subjective_practice.hint: How does a lemon taste? Is it sweet or sour?

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 My Favorite Toy Description
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Hold your favorite toy and say three describing words about it to your family. Is it soft, big, red, or fast?

chapter_summary: ⭐ Describing words tell us more about Naming Words (Nouns).
⭐ Colors, shapes, sizes, and numbers are all describing words.
